project_claims.claim: Fixed-size QR factors and centered training moments preserve the declared chronological pilot tuning and full-history refit under stable numerical conditions; the inherited causal rate assumptions remain separate.

The fixed joint and nested fourfold/eightfold pilot procedures have selected-design coverage, availability and paired uncertainty; small audits, near-rank information and false exogeneity retain material failures.

Selected streaming pilot plus inference agrees numerically with dense requests and reduces complete local memory at the large workload without a consistent speed benefit; pilot acquisition and bank performance are unmeasured.

source_role_limits.J-R01: DML supports the orthogonal score and nuisance-product rate premise. QR equivalence and dependent-calendar rates are project derivations, not consequences of the iid DML theorem.
source_role_limits.J-R02: Coverage, paired comparisons and failures are this project's synthetic evidence. No external paper establishes their finite-sample calibration.
source_role_limits.J-R03: Newey supports the Bartlett covariance alternative and its positive-semidefinite construction. Untapered horizon covariance, streaming equivalence and local cost measurements are project work.
